commit_message:
Sanitize app label in KeyChainActivity to prevent UI injection.

A malicious application could craft a package label containing newlines
or other control characters. When KeyChainActivity displays this label
in the certificate selection prompt, it could be used to manipulate the
text layout and potentially trick the user into approving a malicious
certificate request.

This change sanitizes the application label by removing newline
characters and extra whitespace before displaying it to the user. This
mitigates the UI injection vulnerability.

This is a variant of the vulnerability described in CVE-2017-13295.

Bug: 471173239
Test: Manually verified that an app label with newlines is correctly sanitized in the certificate selection prompt.
Flag: EXEMPT BUGFIX
